title: Prove the non-Fano two-target reader floor
body:
## Summary

```diff
- require every non-Fano subset rank to survive characteristic-two transfer
+ preserve only the source-zero and reader-span conditions for two marked targets
+ transfer both actual supports termwise, then charge the expanded identity
```

Prove the actual-reader floor `sum C(u_i,q_i) >= m_A+m_B` for five-query pair realizations whose seven query/target rays have the non-Fano rank pattern. The proof covers every coefficient field of characteristic other than two, arbitrary external query/readout values, and every finite even binary-orthonormal partition. Three GF4 templates cover all 21 marked pairs.

This closes PR3489's explicit non-Fano exception. Its whole-matroid obstruction remains true; the marked-target conditions are weaker. Other seven-point patterns and a complete five-term theorem remain open. No native program, supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Exact source comparison and predecessor credit are retained in the isolated package.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3489's full-rank transfer stops at the seven-point non-Fano example.
  **After:** all 2,688 marked-target candidates pass, with 288 source-zero and 672 reader-span premises. Integer minors cover all characteristics other than two.
- All 21 literal fixtures have factor ranks `(3,4)`. Both operators contribute 526,848 checked entries; supports, actual rectangular tariffs and all 50,176 expanded-identity entries pass. Fixture bills are not global minima.
- A separate GF16/determinant implementation checks characteristic zero, F3/F5/F7 and binary span-image tariffs on the committed sparse arrays. Seven actual optimized CLI corruptions reject and restoration passes. Three additional copy controls verify exclusive destinations, symlink rejection and unchanged source bytes; copies verify owner and distinct inode and copy no metadata.
- Python3.12 registered replay, warnings-as-errors, focused Ruff/formatting and exact diff/proof review pass. Optional Ruff ALL style diagnostics and omitted sparse selected-orientation dependencies are disclosed in VALIDATION.md.
- At `9e41a7a45adc282ca2bd6b024dfbe726150ab13b`, the committed-byte/source-history gate passes 16 files. All three optimized Python3.15 Git-free export commands pass; all 17 exported regular files remain unchanged.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-nonfano-reader-floor
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-nonfano-reader-floor --check-source-history
```

README.md also gives direct isolated/optimized commands. Use a private external TMPDIR. No full selected replay, Lean, Docker, independent human or formal proof-kernel review is claimed. Full native/physical/compiler/consumer obligations remain separate.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds one self-contained research package. Frozen predecessor bytes, live inputs, shared tooling and the selected record are unchanged.
